fluff.overview: Lyran military budgets translate directly into infantry equipment quality, giving LCAF conventional forces a material edge that compensates for the uneven tactical leadership the social general tradition sometimes produces. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Armed with assault rifles backed by portable machine guns, these platoons combine individual marksmanship with sustained suppressive fire from crew-served weapons that can pin down opposing formations.
